name: ZCA_EXP_VIEWS
description: Contains one record per view object available for export in a view object

columns.name: EXPORT_VIEW_ID
columns.description: Primary Key.

columns.name: SECONDARY_VIEW_OBJECT_DEF
columns.description: The secondary view object associated with this view object, null if one does not exist.

columns.name: OUTPUT_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Output file name expected by Import team, provided from consumer VO's.

columns.name: VIEW_LINK_DEF
columns.description: This field stores the View link Def for this object. This helps to find out the parent-child info

columns.name: PARENT_VIEW_ID
columns.description: Parent view object.  Null for top level views in data model or manually added views

columns.name: EXPORT_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to ZCA_EXP_OBJECTS.EXPORT_OBJECT_ID

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: The name of the object code that owns the view

columns.name: VIEW_NAME
columns.description: Name of the view.  Must be unique within the export object.  System generated.

columns.name: PARENT_VIEW_NAME
columns.description: Name of the parent view, if a view hierarchy is used.  May be null to indicate there is no parent view.

columns.name: DESC_TEXT
columns.description: Human readable description of the view object

columns.name: TABLE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the table the view object is over.

columns.name: VIEW_OBJECT_INSTANCE_NAME
columns.description: The view object instance name in the AM.  NULL for manually added VOs

columns.name: VIEW_ACCESSOR_NAME
columns.description: The name of the view accessor used to "get" to the view object.

columns.name: VIEW_OBJECT_DEF
columns.description: The qualified name (class name) of the view object

columns.name: ASSOC_VIEW_OBJECT_DEF
columns.description: The extensible view object associated with this view object, null if one does not exist.

columns.name: UI_FLAG
columns.description: Determines whether the view object is shown in the export UI.  Y - show, N - hide

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
